Cursed-dusk mood — sickly yellowish-amber fading through grey-green wrongness at the edge of a long-blighted valley, breathing cursed suffocating dread and autumn-finality across the dead-standing and leafless orchard.

Triumphant-return mood — warm amber-gold and honest rose flooding open city gates at the end of an age-long campaign, breathing exultant saga-momentum and solemn banner-raised triumph into the threshold moment.

Sanctum-charged mood — deep gold candlelight and cold blue altar-shadow wrestling without resolution across ancient carved stone faces, breathing sacred recognition and charged oracle-stillness into the consecrated interior chamber.
Mist-dawn mood — pearl-white vapor threaded with pale amber, breathing fragile hopeful serenity through the half-dissolved valleys below.
Blood-dawn mood — blood-orange sky shredded by black volcanic cloud, breathing blade-edge tension and war-horn urgency across the waking ridgelines.
Copper-dawn mood — burnished copper light flooding ash-grey summits, breathing restless awakening energy into every frost-stiffened banner and bough.
Fey-twilight mood — rose-lavender dusk dissolving into silver-green luminescence, breathing serene mystical uncertainty through every leaf-shadow and forest margin.
Ember-dusk mood — deep amber and smoldering rust pooling along the horizon, breathing hollow exhausted melancholy across the cooling embers of the age.
Ash-dusk mood — grey-lilac sky filmed with pale ash-white haze, breathing autumn-finality and quiet ruin into the last light of the ruined citadel.
Silent-noon mood — fierce clean gold hammering pale white stone into silence, breathing oracle-stillness and hush-of-the-ancients across the shadowless plaza.
Judgment-noon mood — sulfur-yellow light thickening beneath a chalk-white vault, breathing suffocating wrongness and breath-held terror into every exposed courtyard.
Wolfsong-night mood — blue-black vault salted with cold silver fires, breathing vast humbling wonder and ancient loneliness across the open tundra.
Ragnarok-edge mood — greenish-black sky veined with livid white lightning, breathing world-ending dread and electric foreboding into the shuddering mountain roots.
Glamour-fog mood — silver-grey luminescence laced with cold blue phosphorescence, breathing charged wonder and dreamlike melancholy through the glamour-hung marshlands.
